summary: Land acquisition compensation dispute; determination of market value using prior reference court order from 1989; annual increase rate calculation controversy (12% flat vs 15% cumulative); reliance on ONGC vs Patel precedent; caution against applying uniform annual escalation beyond 4-5 years; adoption of 12% cumulative annual increase for 5 years from 1993 to 2000; market value fixed at Rs.208.59 per square yard; High Court's 15% cumulative rate set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal partially allowed; High Court's 15% cumulative annual increase set aside; 12% cumulative annual increase for 5 years from reference base period applied; compensation rate of Rs.208.59 per square yard restored.
